html:
The Years of Great Disaster, in Kazakh Aqtaban Shubyryndy, the barefoot flight, were the Dzungar invasion of the Kazakh lands that began in 1723, when Kazakhs fled in panic from their pastures.

The Dzungar Khanate, a Buddhist Oirat Mongol state, attacked in force and took the cities along the Syr Darya, including Turkistan and Tashkent. Many Kazakhs died, and many more fled west and south with their herds, leaving pastures behind.

The three hordes later united and won victories in the late 1720s, remembered as the battle of Anrakay among others. But the Little Horde under Abulkhair Khan asked for Russian protection in 1731, the first step in the Russian Empire's absorption of the steppe. The Qing destruction of the Dzungars in the 1750s ended the threat, and Ablai Khan took back the eastern lands.
